label: Browser extension
summary: Popup, side panel, options page or content-script UI

choices.label: UI injected into web pages (overlay, button, tooltip)

options.question: Follow the browser's light and dark theme?

preview_screen: The primary surface (popup or side panel) at its real size, with realistic content.
required_states: Disabled on the current page (unsupported site)
Badge states on the toolbar icon
design_guidance: Respect the fixed surface sizes; popups cannot scroll gracefully, so keep content short.
Injected UI must not hide or break the host page; show it on a neutral sample page background.
Explain each permission the extension requests in plain language.

checks: Every surface is designed at its real size and nothing is clipped at it.
Injected UI is shown over both a light and a dark sample page and stays legible.
Permissions are explained before they are requested.
The toolbar icon and badge states are designed, including disabled.
